overview.description: The BNY Mellon Emerging Markets Equity ETF (BKEM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is a passively managed fund with emerging market exposure to broad large- and mid-cap stocks, selected and weighted by market cap. BKEM was launched on Apr 24, 2020 and is issued by BNY Mellon.
